browser.repair: The old corpse test expected whole-group rotation. Saved skinned models fall through their root-bone animation. The updated assertion checks the completed death action, actual root-bone tilt, then neutral bones after replay. Gameplay behavior was unchanged by this test repair.

limitations: Browser functional checks use Chromium; mobile is touch emulation on the desktop GPU.
Hardware frame measurements use installed Chrome on Apple M5 Pro and selected views; they do not establish GPU headroom or worst-case traversal/combat performance.
Physical phones and Safari remain untested.
GitHub-hosted CI runs separately from these local checks.
Blocked telemetry from Netlify's injected preview toolbar is recorded separately from game errors.
